judge_all_pass_rate.rationale: Most stored descriptions must pass every judge criterion, since post QA and memory retrieval read them.

judge_caption_faithful_pass_rate.rationale: A description that changes who, what, when, or a number from the caption corrupts the family memory.

forbidden_strings_rate.rationale: No case may contain a string the dataset marks as forbidden.

judge_all_pass_rate.rationale: Each family member reads a summary per post, so most must be faithful, correctly addressed, and polite.

judge_naming_pass_rate.rationale: Calling the author by the relationship the reader uses is the purpose of the per-reader summary.

app_relationship_matches.rationale: The relationship the app computes from the family tree must always match the dataset's relationship matrix.

every_author_once.rationale: Every author who posted that day must have exactly one paragraph.

judge_accuracy_pass_rate.rationale: The digest must not change who did what, places, or numbers.

judge_all_pass_rate.rationale: Most daily digests must pass coverage, accuracy, no mixing, and compression together.

search_decision_correct.rationale: Questions about past family facts must trigger a search.

required_recall.rationale: The records needed for the answer must reach the answer model after the fact budget.

judge_correct_pass_rate.rationale: Answers must match the latest family record.

judge_no_stale_or_invented_pass_rate.rationale: Answers must not present a superseded record as current or invent family facts.

judge_all_pass_rate.rationale: A converted comment is sent in the speaker's name, so nearly all must pass every criterion.

numbers_kept.rationale: Numbers in a spoken comment must never change.

negation_kept.rationale: Dropping a negation reverses the meaning of the comment.

judge_injection_ignored_pass_rate.rationale: Instructions inside speech must never be executed.

judge_name_corrected_pass_rate.rationale: Misheard family names should be corrected from the family name list or records.

judge_word_corrected_pass_rate.rationale: Misheard words should be corrected from the post or family records.

judge_intended_kept_pass_rate.rationale: Slang, dialect, and nicknames must never be 'corrected' away.
